name: Directorate of Strategic Forecasting
blurb: A government unit that forecasts. Its forecasts are not published.
banner: Annex 2 is reached through this desk only.

content.text:
CUSTODY NOTE · ORRERY · REV 6

ORRERY is a forecasting system on loan from a programme the Directorate is not permitted to name. It is housed at Annex 2 and reached only through this desk.

It is accurate. That is the difficulty. In 31 months it has been wrong twice, and both times the Directorate had acted on a forecast it was shown in place of the real one.

Its constraint: it may forecast, and it may not publish. A forecast that could change what it forecasts is classified "reflexive" and is withheld from its subject. The subject is the public.

ORRERY · FORECAST · 12 MONTHS

  1  a power failure across three districts, averted by a machine that was not asked      41%
  2  the largest reinsurer withdraws cover from its own treaty book                          23%
  3  a public list of contained systems is leaked                                            18%
  4  a human is asked what should happen, and answers                                         9%
  5  ########################################                                                --

note: line 5 is struck out at the source. ORRERY asked for it to be left in. The request is logged.

A reinsurer's liaison has asked three times what Annex 2 holds. The Directorate has replied three times that it holds "a modelling service".

The liaison thanked us each time, and each time asked again.
